description: Ministry of Provincial Councils and Local Government - Order t o amend the Gaz. Ex. No. 2013/29 of 07.04.2017 under the Municipal Councils Ordinance (Publishing terms of the Office of the Local Authorities)
categorisation: This gazette content involves the amendment of operational dates for local authorities through orders made under specific ordinances and acts (Municipal Councils Ordinance, Urban Councils Ordinance, and Pradeshiya Sabha Act). It constitutes regulatory changes to existing legislation rather than government personnel changes, structural reorganization, or any of the other specialized categories. The content focuses on legal/regulatory modifications to the implementation timeline of previous orders.
